title: The Stream – Activity Log & Audit Trail plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting…
description: The Stream – Activity Log & Audit Trail plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 4.4.0 contains a stored DOM-based cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'display_name' parameter. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages. This vulnerability is limited to sites with 50 or fewer users, as larger sites use an AJAX endpoint that properly encodes output and mitigates the issue.
